messages:
matt: heads-up – deploybot blocked the staging->canary promote for release v1.2.3. it refused to promote the tag.
anika: saw that, noticed tag v1.2.3 points to sha256:old but registry mirror returned sha256:new during verification.
vic: can you paste the exact deploybot error?
anika: deploybot: promotion halted: provenance-overlay checksum mismatch (expected sha256:old, found sha256:new). action: manual review required.
julio: quick check — run local ECR lookup?
anika: run: `aws ecr batch-get-image --repository-name redwood/service --image-ids imageTag=v1.2.3 --region us-east-1`
anika: output snippet: `imageDigest: sha256:new`, `imageTag: v1.2.3`, publishMetadata.checksum: sha256:old`
vic: hmm, looks like a metadata overlay applied after our staging publish. could be the mirror job or artifact-lifecycle race.
matt: risk: if we let automated promote continue we might put mismatched provenance in prod. rollback complexity is high.
srebot: FYI: I locked the production promotion window for 60m starting at 2024-07-12T16:00Z to avoid accidental rollouts. :lock:
anika: proposal: manual promote by digest (pin to sha256:new) with an explicit release-note entry noting republish and provenance mismatch, then run republish job to reconcile overlays.
vic: question: do we know which registry/mirror changed the overlay? Julio?
julio: looking at mirror logs — there was a retry in eu-mirror that reapplied metadata overlay after digest rotation. file: `/var/log/mirror/2024-07-12T15:05Z.log` shows `overlay write succeed for tag v1.2.3 -> sha256:new`
matt: ok. two actions: 1) manual promote to the digest currently present (sha256:new) so canaries can run, 2) trigger republish-and-reverify for staging images to restore provenance to canonical expected digest, with a TTL prevent re-overlay.
anika: i'll update release notes: "Manual promotion pinned to digest sha256:new due to mirror metadata overlay; follow-up republish scheduled. Do not rely on tag name immutability for this window."
vic: add rollback playbook in the note: how to revert to previous digest if service regressions observed. short steps please.
anika: rollback playbook added to notes: `1) stop canary route 2) redeploy previous task def with imageDigest=sha256:old 3) monitor 5m 4) escalate to oncall if any crashloop`
srebot: tagging the oncall rota: @oncall-engineering notified for standby during manual promote.
matt: thumbs-up. also add a follow-up ticket to devinfra to add idempotent overlay writes check.
julio: creating ticket INFRA-1278 now, will include mirror logs and timestamps.
anika: executing manual promote command: `deploybot promote --repo redwood/service --digest sha256:new --force-manual`
deploybot: manual promotion accepted by operator anika. promoting tag v1.2.3 -> digest sha256:new to canary.
deploybot: canary deploy started. health-checks: pending.
anika: canary probes green on app-level, latency within SLO so far.
deploybot: canary promotion complete, routes updated for 10% traffic.
matt: good. assign follow-up: republish job + provenance reverify before final promote to prod.
anika: scheduled republish job for 2024-07-12T17:00Z, will post results in this thread.
julio: note — we'll add a guard to deploybot: if overlay timestamp > publish timestamp by >10s, block automatic promote.
vic: agreed. thanks everyone. :thumbsup:
